PLAYER SUPPORT

Let’s get you
back in flight.

A few quick checks for your next session, plus a clear way to report an issue.

Camera not starting?

  1. Check that camera permission is enabled for Flap Fit in your phone settings.
  2. Make sure you have a connection for the tracking software download.
  3. Close other apps using the camera, return to Flap Fit, and try again.

Movement not lining up?

Use even lighting and a stable phone position. Keep your full movement in frame, then repeat the in-game calibration. Visit the exercise guide for the setup that matches your move.

Camera tracking is a game control, not a form check. Keep your movement comfortable and prioritize safe exercise over a score.

Scores or challenges not loading?

Check your connection, then refresh the Compete screen. Leaderboards are grouped by exercise. Make sure your challenge code is entered correctly.

CONTACT FLAP FIT

Need a hand?

The support address is not yet configured for this private draft. A working support contact will be added before launch.

For an issue report, include what happened, steps to reproduce it, your phone model, operating system, and Flap Fit version. Please leave out passwords and camera footage.
